note: How each scene folder under ~/goat-rig/rt2-scenes on the 5900X was exported (debug.rt_export, HALO_RT_EXPORT). Run from a checkout with the export branch built on the rig; check no player's game is running first.

c20_corner.build: local/rt2-export-tangents (rt2/export with tangents; any build with rt_export)
c20_corner.command: tools/rig/goat-rig @5900x run rt2x-c20 --build <ref> --shared --size 1920x1080 --seconds 30 -- 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST=campaign:levels\c20\c20' HALO_NETWORK_TEST_START=2 HALO_SKIP_CINEMATICS=1 HALO_GRAPHICS=classic HALO_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS=classic HALO_SHADOWS=classic HALO_NET_BROADCAST=127.255.255.255 HALO_FRAME_TIME=0.0333333333 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST_PLACE=-26.65 15.71 -4.6 -70 -8@8' 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST_CUES=5 ai_erase_all|5.1 render_shadows 0|9 debug_object_place "characters\floodcombat_human\floodcombat_human -25.42 12.33 -4.5 110"|10 show_hud 0' 'HALO_TEST_INPUT=script:12.5-13 flashlight' 'HALO_RT_EXPORT=14.5 /home/<user>/goat-rig/rt2-scenes/c20_corner_new'
c20_corner.then: move c20_corner_new into place as c20_corner (keep the previous as c20_corner_prev until the new one's counts and its overlay with original.png check out)

b30_combat.matches: rt2_scorecard combat.hrpl frame 480 (tick 1369 drawn, export written before tick 1370; camera position/forward/up equal the recording's marks to 6 digits)
b30_combat.command: tools/rig/goat-rig @5900x run rt2x-b30combat --build <ref> --shared --size 1920x1080 --seconds 120 -- 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST=campaign:levels\b30\b30' HALO_NETWORK_TEST_START=2 HALO_SKIP_CINEMATICS=1 HALO_GRAPHICS=classic HALO_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS=classic HALO_SHADOWS=classic HALO_NET_BROADCAST=127.255.255.255 HALO_FRAME_TIME=0.0333333333 'HALO_TEST_INPUT=script:34-43 move=0,1' 'HALO_RT_EXPORT=45.6 /home/<user>/goat-rig/rt2-scenes/b30_combat' HALO_SCREENSHOT_AT=47,quit
b30_combat.then: rt2_mask.py b30_combat, then add mask rect [336,892,648,936] (the B: SPARTAN LINK prompt; HUD is on, as in the recording)

a10_interior.build: local/rt2-export-tangents (self-illumination and change colors as drawn)
a10_interior.command: tools/rig/goat-rig @5900x run rt2x-a10 --build <ref> --shared --size 1920x1080 --seconds 50 -- 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST=local:levels\a10\a10:coop' 'HALO_TEST_INPUT=script:1 jump; 2 jump; 3 jump' HALO_SKIP_CINEMATICS=1 HALO_GRAPHICS=classic HALO_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS=classic HALO_SHADOWS=classic HALO_NET_BROADCAST=127.255.255.255 HALO_FRAME_TIME=0.0333333333 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST_CUES=2 debug_camera_set "-55.4 0.8 0.62 0 -12 0 70"|6 debug_camera_set "-55.4 0.8 0.62 0 -12 0 70"|10 debug_camera_set "-55.4 0.8 0.62 0 -12 0 70"|14 debug_camera_set "-55.4 0.8 0.62 0 -12 0 70"|18 debug_camera_set "-55.4 0.8 0.62 0 -12 0 70"|18.5 show_hud 0' 'HALO_RT_EXPORT=22.13 /home/<user>/goat-rig/rt2-scenes/a10_interior_new'
a10_interior.then: HALO_RT_EXPORT 22.13 gives tick 666 (21.9 gives 659); move a10_interior_new into place, the previous kept as a10_interior_prev

any_bsp.use: emitter solves (python -m rt_truth emitters): one export a BSP; the camera does not matter (the whole BSP is used). <map> and <k> as in <map>_bsp<k>; switch_bsp moves the game to BSP k (an index past the scenario's last leaves it on 0: check export.json's bsp_index)
any_bsp.command: tools/rig/goat-rig @5900x run rt2em-<map>-<k> --build master --shared --size 1280x720 --seconds 30 -- 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST=campaign:levels\\<map>\\<map>' HALO_NETWORK_TEST_START=2 HALO_SKIP_CINEMATICS=1 HALO_GRAPHICS=classic HALO_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS=classic HALO_SHADOWS=classic HALO_NET_BROADCAST=127.255.255.255 HALO_FRAME_TIME=0.0333333333 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST_CUES=3 ai_erase_all|4 switch_bsp <k>|5 show_hud 0' 'HALO_RT_EXPORT=9 /home/<user>/goat-rig/<your folder>/<map>_bsp<k>'
any_bsp.then: python -m rt_truth emitters <folder> --spp 2048 --out port/assets/emitters/<map>_bsp<k>.json (2048: the cells' match is the same at 4096; 128 was not stable)
